Formula Objective of the p-median operation, not the greedy and swap procedure: Z = sum over reachable demand rows j of w_j * min over selected facilities i in S of c_ji, with |S| <= p. Unreachable rows (infinite cost to every selected facility) are left out of Z and counted in the uncovered status word. Maximum coverage instead sums the weight of rows within coverageDistance, and set covering counts selected facilities.
